card.name: Spots just before a type or group label
card.fires_on: Words or spaces right before a category label such as Type, Group or a numbered class, e.g. 'known as', 'classified as', 'Group ' or an opening parenthesis before a defining term.

modes.label: Linking word before a class name
modes.description: A word like 'as' or a space after 'Group' that leads into a numbered type or class.
modes.example: they were divided into two types known<< as>> Seyfert 1 and 2

modes.label: Parenthesis before a defining term
modes.description: An opening bracket that introduces a defining phrase or category.

modes.label: Inside a type name
modes.description: Partway through a disease or class name just before 'type' and a number.
modes.example: multiple endocrine neoplas<<ia>> type I are at risk

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word Type or Level next, as in 'Type 1' or 'Group 1'.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a type or class, such as 'Type 2' or 'Group 1'.
